root_cause_details: Input deck PK_SEC43_JOB2_ADAPTED_PROD.inp specified *STATIC, DIRECT (single-iteration operator split incrementation). However, monolithic block-coupled subroutine f42_mixed_uel.for (which lacks off-diagonal tangent cross-coupling terms) was compiled. At crack initiation from notch tip (node 2238) at increment 98 (uy=0.0490 mm), block-coupled Newton iterations diverged. Because cutbacks are prohibited under *STATIC, DIRECT, Abaqus immediately terminated with FIXED TIME INCREMENT IS TOO LARGE.
